blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Digital rights group Digital Pinoys is urging transport network companies (TNCs) to implement the authorized pick-up fare scheme immediately, saying delays in updating their platforms could affect both drivers and commuters. The group made the call after the inDrive country manager acknowledged in a recent radio interview that the platform’s system for implementing the pick-up fare is still being developed. Digital Pinoys said technical adjustments may be necessary but should not unnecessarily delay the implementation of the approved fare. “Implementation should not be unnecessarily delayed,” the group said, noting that ride-hailing drivers are already facing higher operating costs, including fuel […]...
